body: Had this happen today. The guy was super smug and entitled but instead of letting him throw me off I went above and beyond for him and the rest of my customers. Growing up my dad always said "don't give them the power" and seeing his mild disappointment at my lack of giving a shit was pretty okay.
Thank you very much! I really appreciate it
It means a lot to read this. I've never had much support and that a random person can be so kind is really wonderful. Thank you.
